value.signature: fn body_projection (body : & ProposalBody) -> Result < Value , ProfileError >

review.body: { let value = structural_value (body) ; if value . canonical_len () > BODY_LIMIT { return Err (ProfileError :: Bound) ; } validate_body (body) ? ; Ok (value) }
review.item_premise: The typed B3 body has public structural fields; the canonical projection is public and establishes shape only.
